# Plasticity Brain Centers

> > Plasticity Brain Centers offers neuroplasticity-based neurological rehabilitation using functional neurology, vestibular therapy, and brain training to treat brain injuries, neurological conditions, and neurodevelopmental disorders across Colorado and Florida locations.

Plasticity Brain Centers specializes in evidence-based neurological care using advanced diagnostic tools like posturography and saccadometry, combined with innovative therapies including primitive reflex integration and rhythmic movement therapies. The centers treat a wide range of conditions from concussions and strokes to autism, ADHD, and Parkinson's disease through personalized, neuroplasticity-driven treatment protocols.

## Neurological Conditions Treated

- [Concussion and Brain Injury Treatment](https://www.plasticitycenters.com/what-we-treat/concussion-brain-injury): Concussion and TBI treatment using neuroplasticity-based therapies and cognitive rehabilitation.
- [Stroke Treatment](https://www.plasticitycenters.com/what-we-treat/stroke): Stroke recovery and neurological rehabilitation using advanced treatment protocols.
- [Vestibular Disorders & Balance Rehabilitation](https://www.plasticitycenters.com/what-we-treat/vestibular-disorders): Vestibular disorder and balance rehabilitation including Mal de Débarquement Syndrome.
- [Dysautonomia Treatment](https://www.plasticitycenters.com/what-we-treat/dysautonomia): Dysautonomia treatment addressing autonomic nervous system dysfunction.
- [Headache and Migraine Treatment](https://www.plasticitycenters.com/what-we-treat/headache-migraine): Specialized headache and migraine treatment targeting root causes.
- [Parkinson's Disease & Pre-Alzheimer Treatment](https://www.plasticitycenters.com/what-we-treat/parkinsons-disease): Parkinson's Disease and pre-Alzheimer's treatment improving brain function.
- [Cerebral Palsy & Hypoxic Injuries](https://www.plasticitycenters.com/what-we-treat/cerebral-palsy-hypoxic-injuries): Cerebral Palsy and hypoxic injury treatment enhancing mobility and cognitive function.

## Neurodevelopmental & Learning Disorders

- [Autism Spectrum Disorder Support](https://www.plasticitycenters.com/what-we-treat/autism): Autism Spectrum Disorder therapies promoting cognitive development and daily functioning.
- [ADHD & Dyslexia Treatment](https://www.plasticitycenters.com/what-we-treat/adhd-dyslexia): ADHD and dyslexia treatment for learning disorders and neurological conditions.
- [Cognitive Challenges Treatment](https://www.plasticitycenters.com/what-we-treat/cognitive-challenges): Cognitive challenge treatment through brain training and sensory processing therapy.

## Treatment Approach & Process

- [Our Treatment Options](https://www.plasticitycenters.com/treatment-options): Personalized treatment options including oculomotor assessment and reflex integration.
- [Our Process - Seven-Step Recovery](https://www.plasticitycenters.com/what-to-expect/our-process): Seven-step brain injury recovery process using posturography and neurological assessment.
- [Innovative Approach to Neurological Rehabilitation](https://www.plasticitycenters.com/what-to-expect/approaches-to-neurological-care): Functional neurology, physical therapy, and vestibular therapy approaches.
